Cliopatria's Kingdom of Dunoting (Yorkshire Dales, 2.39-1.89 W, 53.66-54.41 N) carries the Wikipedia title Dunoding, which is the Welsh Dunoding in Gwynedd: the row's title does not fit its shape (kingdom-of-dunoting author and data notes).

Neighbour-side defects for their authors: kingdom-of-alba ledger 1034 takes only the 40-cell Clyde shape, leaving 25 Cumbrian cells in no Alba shape until norman-england ledger 4 (1092); brythons still draws 18 Cumbrian cells in 1034 and its ledger 24 (900) duplicates Strathclyde's gain; dal-riata has no 750 gain from Strathclyde; kingdom-of-england's 937 vassal_end for Strathclyde is confidence 1 where the Aethelstan page supports 2.

New keyframes kingdom-of-northumbria_900 (900-925) and strathclyde_900 (900-959) overlap the Cliopatria shape of their year range; they follow the group's convention that a new keyframe overrides the Cliopatria shape in the years it covers.
The Eamont meeting is 12 July 927 (Aethelstan page) and 27 July 927 (Strathclyde page); the vassal events use 12 July.
